summary: This is an 8-K filed by Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc. on behalf of issuing entity BANK5 2023-5YR2, an ABS commercial mortgage securitization trust. The filing discloses that effective September 1, 2026, C-IV Asset Management LLC replaced Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer for two mortgage loans after Greystone sold its special servicing division. This is a routine servicing transfer notification under Item 8.01, not a special situation. No securities, shareholders, or deal terms are involved; the filing simply informs noteholders of a servicing administration change within the securitization's governance framework.
